name: Citlekci Magazacilik Gida Anonim Sirketi
summary: Citlekci Magazacilik Gida Anonim Sirketi engages in the retail chain of variety of nuts, dried fruits, chocolates, and confectionery products in Turkey. The company offers products, such as roasted nuts, dried fruits including mulberries, raisins, figs, apricots, apples, oranges, traditional Turkish delights (lokum), chocolates, dragees, coffees, and teas. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ankara, Turkey. Citlekci Magazacilik Gida Anonim Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Tunçlar Yatirim Holding Anonim Sirketi.
